item.title: California Democrat Rep. Gomez resigns following ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations
item.description: California Congressman Rep. Jimmy Gomez says he will resign after a House Ethics report concluded Gomez's actions violated House rules by "making unwelcome sexual advances."

item.title: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
item.description: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.

item.title: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
item.description:
Women who have advocated for DEI in tech say Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA as CEO sends a message that in Silicon Valley, all that matters is money.

item.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
item.description: Democrats have currently flipped 47 House seats and could flip 49 total. And, climate change talks at COP31 ran two days longer than expected, becoming the longest conference in the summit's history.

item.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
item.description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

item.title: K is for kindness, but families worry the world has less of it
item.description: A decade after first asking families about kindness, Sesame Workshop asked parents similar questions. They responded that their kids are getting kinder even as the wider world becomes less so.
